highlights.title: Devas & Planetars
highlights.summary: Summoned Devas (3 turns) and Planetars (2 turns) are rebalanced without permanent Haste, capped at 1 Deva and 1 Planetar at a time.
bullets: Planetars have 18 HD and 152 HP (without permanent Haste); Devas have 14 HD and 136 HP, and you control their full spellbooks.
Takes 1 round to cast (casting time 9, 30-ft. range), and Death Spell no longer instakills summoned Devas or Planetars.
Party cap allows up to one Deva (or Fallen Deva) and one Planetar (or Dark Planetar) on the field at the same time.
openQuestions: Are the 2–3 turn durations and Planetar stats without permanent Haste strong enough for ToB fights?
Should 1 Deva + 1 Planetar remain allowed together, or should the cap be 1 celestial total?

highlights.title: Improved Haste & Attack Cap
highlights.summary: Reworked from single-target double attacks (up to 10 APR) into a 15-ft. party combat buff granting +1 extra attack, +2 THAC0, +2 AC, and +2 Save vs. Breath.
bullets: Lasts 1 turn (casting time 6), grants +6 movement rate and Slow immunity, and caps extra attacks from Haste, Improved Haste, and Righteous Wrath at +1 total (with EEex).
Haste and Slow cancel each other across both spells and items.
openQuestions: Should we buff this party-wide version further, or let Improved Haste raise the attack cap (for example to 6–7 APR with EEex) instead of doubling attacks to 10?

highlights.title: Dispelling Screen & Pierce Magic
highlights.summary: Dispelling Screen replaces Spell Immunity with a 15-ft. party ward that absorbs one Breach or Dispel/Remove Magic.
bullets: Lasts 5 turns; enemy mages whose scripts cast Spell Immunity automatically cast Dispelling Screen instead.
Pierce Magic strips one spell protection up to 8th level and halves the target's current Magic Resistance (10%–40% for 5 rounds, with EEex); Lower Resistance removes 30% + 1% per level.
openQuestions: Should Dispelling Screen get a brief ~1-second grace window when triggered so a double-dispel sequencer doesn't strip everything at once?
How should Breach and dispels interact with Entropy Shield once enemy AI uses it?

highlights.title: Typed Bonuses & Transformations
highlights.summary: Six bonus types (Morale, Favor, Luck, Dodge, Deflection, Curse) and exclusive Transformation spells prevent endless pre-buff stacking.
bullets: Only the highest bonus (or penalty) of each type counts per stat; weaker buffs stay running underneath if a stronger short buff expires.
Strength buffs raise low Strength up to their target value without overwriting higher Strength from belts, gauntlets, or potions (with EEex).
openQuestions: Does typed buff stacking make pre-buffing feel better, or is there a classic combo you miss?

highlights.title: Wake on Damage, Saves & Clones
highlights.summary: Sleeping and unconscious foes wake when hit, area blasts use Save vs. Breath and ignore Mirror Image, and clones can't abuse quick-slot items.
bullets: Taking damage wakes sleeping or unconscious targets hit by Sleep, Color Spray, Command, Greater Command, Stinking Cloud, or Emotion: Hopelessness.
Skull Trap caps at 12d6; Project Image and Simulacrum can no longer use quick-slot items, while Simulacrum keeps its level-appropriate class abilities and HLAs (with EEex).
Polymorph Self and Shapechange each offer 6 reworked forms with accurate combat stats and clear spellcasting rules.

highlights.title: Faster Divine Casting & 6 New Spells
highlights.summary: Faster divine casting times, stronger Cure and Cause Wounds scaling, enemy-only Silence, and six new Wizard and Divine spells.
bullets: Cure and Cause Wounds scale from 1d8+5 (casting time 4) up to 4d8+12 (casting time 7), with Cause Wounds and Harm healing undead instead of hurting them; Heal drops to casting time 6.
Six new spells: Faerie Fire (L1), Icelance (L3 Druid), Protection from Cold (L3), Protection from Acid (L4), Mass Regenerate (L5), and Conjure Air Elemental (L6 Druid).

systemRules.title: AoE Damage Bypasses Mirror Image
systemRules.summary: Area-of-effect damage from spells, breath weapons, traps, and items (Fireball, Skull Trap, Horrid Wilting, etc.) hits right through Mirror Image, while single-target spells and attacks still pop images.

systemRules.title: Dispel Destroys Created Weapons & Nishruu/Hakeashar
systemRules.summary: Dispel Magic, Remove Magic, Inquisitor Dispel, and magic-dispelling attacks (such as Nishruu hits) now remove conjured spell weapons (Flame Blade, Phantom Blade, Melf's Minute Meteors, etc.) and unsummon Nishruu and Hakeashar.

systemRules.title: Universal Utility Schools & Specialist Access
systemRules.summary: Find Familiar, Minor Sequencer, Contingency, Spell Sequencer, Spell Trigger, and Chain Contingency now belong to the Universal school so every specialist mage can learn and cast them. Cloud spells move to Conjuration, and Power Word: Sleep moves to Enchantment.

systemRules.title: Web, Grease, Entangle & Stinking Cloud Immunities
systemRules.summary: Ghosts and other incorporeal creatures, dragons, beholders, mephits, and giant monsters ignore ground hazards like Grease, Entangle, and Web where appropriate; creatures that don't breathe (undead, golems, elementals, and slimes) are immune to Stinking Cloud.

systemRules.title: Druid Sphere & Three New Druid Spells
systemRules.summary: Barkskin, Shillelagh, Flame Blade, Animal Summoning I–III, and Conjure Animals are now exclusive to Druids and Rangers, joined by three new Druid spells: Faerie Fire (L1), Icelance (L3), and Conjure Air Elemental (L6).

systemRules.title: Simulacrum & Project Image Restrictions
systemRules.summary: Projected images can cast spells but cannot use quick-slot items or innate abilities. Simulacrum clones also lose quick-slot items, and with EEex they keep the exact class/kit abilities and HLAs matching their drained level.
